title: Derive implementation obligations from product graph
goal: Derive deterministic implementation obligations from explicit canonical product evidence without inventing implementation semantics.
definition_of_done: every obligation records one or more source paths
every active registered capability produces a capability obligation
every active registered screen produces a screen obligation
referenced historical identifiers remain traceable but do not become active obligations
obligation output records unresolved references separately from active obligations
tests cover provenance, deduplication and exclusion of reference-only historical entities
CI derives obligations on the full canonical corpus
